text:
Alex Chen: FYI p99 on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate spiked to ~1.9s right after a quota fallback at ~11:23 UTC. p50 unchanged. Anyone saw this in traces?

quota-bot: AUTO: quota-fallback applied tenant=acme-inc at 2025-08-12T11:23:07Z -> routed to pool 'dedicated-low-priority'

Maia Singh: that fallback pool runs on a slower GPU and uses quant-8 variants. makes sense that tail moves while median doesn't.

Devon Park: I pulled console numbers: p50 430ms -> 460ms, p95 620ms -> 640ms, p99 jumped from ~480ms -> ~1900ms. Need per-host breakdown; the rollup could be hiding a single host with huge queueing.

Sophie Ramos: can you paste the exact console query you used? want to confirm whether sample_origin or tdigest merging influenced the endpoint-level p99.

Alex Chen: query I ran:
```
SELECT pctile(latency_ms, [50,95,99]) FROM latency WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND env='prod' AND window='5m' GROUP BY host
```
Snapshot:
- gen-eu-1: p50=445ms p95=630ms p99=1899ms
- gen-eu-2: p50=420ms p95=610ms p99=470ms

Maia Singh: looks like gen-eu-1 got overloaded. Check rollout weights and routing policy; fallback might have concentrated traffic.

Devon Park: also check sample_origin tag. If we merge tdigest sketches from different origins (proxy vs agent) without normalizing for sample_count we can inflate p99.

Sophie Ramos: @Alex can you share routing-weight changes and any deployment/rollout events around 11:22-11:24? Also ask eng-runtime to confirm KV cache warmness. cold KV + queueing = nasty tails.

Alex Chen: uploaded a weight-change screenshot and logs:
```
2025-08-12T11:22:58Z gen-eu-1 queue_len=120 avg=190ms
2025-08-12T11:23:03Z gen-eu-1 queue_len=560 avg=430ms p99=1899ms
```
obs-bot: ALERT: queue_len gen-eu-1 > 500 (alert Q-2025-876)

Maia Singh: hypothesis: quota fallback -> sudden traffic shift -> single host queue storm -> endpoint p99 spikes while p50 stable. Two asks: 1) Console UX: surface sample_origin counts and show annotations for fallback events. 2) Routing: add a spread limiter so fallback traffic isn't dumped onto few hosts.

Devon Park: +1. From a backend POV we should consider count-weighted merging for tdigest or expose raw-sample p99 on hover. I'll prototype a diff comparing merged p99 vs raw samples.

Sophie Ramos: I'll open an eng-platform ticket for the UX changes and tag eng-runtime for routing policy. Short-term: auto-annotate the latency charts when quota-fallback events and p99 spikes co-occur. That should speed triage.

Alex Chen: agreed. also add a runbook blurb: if p99 >> p95, check for concurrent fallback events and per-host queue_len.

Devon Park: will post prototype query/gist in a bit that computes per-host raw p99 and compares to tdigest-merged p99. early findings suggest merged p99 can be biased when a host with low sample_count has extreme tail.

Maia Singh: if we can detect that pattern automatically we could flag "merging artifact" on the dashboard so support knows it's a rollup issue.

Sophie Ramos: Ticket created: PLAT-1229 'dashboard: show sample_origin & annotate fallback events' (owner: Sophie Ramos). Routing follow-up ticket: RUNTIME-804 'fallback spread limiter' (requested to eng-runtime).

Alex Chen: thanks team. leaving thread open while Devon posts numbers. ping me if spike repeats.

Devon Park: gist posted: https://gist.github.com/devon/abcdef - includes query and churned numbers per host. will follow up with a short repro scenario for the tdigest merge artifact. :hammer_and_wrench:

Sophie Ramos: perfect, thanks. we'll decide whether to change merge semantics or just surface more provenance info after Devon's numbers.
